description: Narrative findings from the xebench cross-engine benchmark, published as data so consumers render the lab's wording verbatim and never re-word a claim. Schema: data/findings.schema.json.

findings.headline: LiteRT-LM on NPU: POCO F8 Ultra only
findings.deck: Gemma 3 1B runs with correct output on the POCO F8 Ultra's NPU (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5). On the Galaxy S23 (Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy), Google's published model bundle drops part of long prompts, a known LiteRT-LM issue.
claims: The NPU path needs four pieces: the litertlm-android AAR, Google's litert-npu-runtime-qualcomm (it provides libLiteRtDispatch_Qualcomm.so; 2.3.0 tested), a QAIRT version that matches the release's LITERT_REF, and <uses-native-library> manifest declarations.
A version mismatch logs 'Unsupported dispatch runtime version'; the Kotlin API reports only 'Failed to create engine'.
LiteRT-LM CPU and GPU output also passes the correctness gate on both phones.

This board has a lab-measured LiteRT-LM NPU row for the POCO F8 Ultra, whose backend is confirmed from the app's own log of each measured load. It has no LiteRT-LM GPU row: nothing in the record confirms that the GPU executes.
